:::{#exm-optimization-algorithm}
#### Exact and greedy searches

For the sum of squared errors over the polynomials in @exm-objective-function,
solving the normal equations is an [optimization algorithm](#def-optimization-algorithm) that finds the unique minimizer in one step,
with no starting values or stopping rule.

Growing a regression tree is different:
it splits the covariate space one split at a time and keeps the best split at each step,
so it stops at a rule that need not minimize the objective function over all trees.

:::
